We evaluated repository hygiene, CI/CD configuration, dependency management, testing, and security practices of the auxiliary meta/benchmarking tooling, recording relevant DevOps best-practice findings such as the absence of CI/CD workflows, unpinned binary/package installations, and lack of dependency manifests and automated tests for automation scripts.
